name: Coauthor CS
description: A computer science co-authorship graph with about 18,000 nodes; the benchmark also includes Coauthor Physics as a related dataset. No data is vendored in this record.
citation: Shchur, O., Mumme, M., Bojchevski, A., & Günnemann, S. (2019). The Amazon co-purchasing and Coauthor CS graphs: A benchmark for graph neural network research. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2019).
